nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
An ancient snow-mountain sacred forest at dusk. Towering cedars heavy with snow, a half-frozen stream winding through the woods toward a broken cliff and a half-collapsed ancient shrine — a torii with peeling vermilion lacquer leaning in the snow, its shimenawa rope hung with icicles, blizzard wind howling and coiling between the trees. A fox-spirit wanderer (character reference "ORIENTAL FOX WANDERER": extremely long straight dark-purple hair falling to her legs, a wide woven straw hat adorned with white flowers, red tassels, and a white fox mask hung at its side, a deep purple kimono mini-dress with white-violet floral embroidery, one white-patterned sleeve slipped off the shoulder, a gold rope belt carrying a black lacquered scabbard, red thigh cord, black armored over-knee boots on gold-soled high platform geta-style heels, a full golden-brown fox tail behind her, a katana with a gold tsuba at her hip) stands still in the snow, the tassels at her hat brim swaying in the wind.

[0-3s] Combat erupts in the first second: the snow-mist between the trees detonates — a white wolf god the size of a mountain lunges at full speed: its body white as a snow peak, shoulders above the cedar canopy, eyes burning with ice-blue divine light, faded shimenawa ropes and torn paper streamers tangled in its mane; its colossal claw rakes down — tearing the earth open, frozen soil and snow bursting like a wave, five deep trenches plowed through the forest. A blink before impact she glides aside, hat brim low, fox tail carving an arc — and on landing, draws in a single motion: an iai flash, purple-white blade-light slashing across the claw's flank in a burst of ice shards and sparks. The shockwave whips wind and snow into a ring-shaped blizzard through the entire forest. Camera cuts from the frontal wide of the exploding mist to tight tracking on her glide, a single-frame micro-freeze at the draw, blade afterglow slicing the snowstorm.

[3-6s] High-speed weaving through the woods: the wolf god chains its pounces, each landing shaking cascades of snow from the canopy — she streaks between the cedars: triangle-jumping sideways off trunks, skimming the half-frozen stream (toes tapping the ice, cracks spidering open behind her), sliding low beneath a shattered trunk sent spinning by the wolf's bulk. Catching the gap after a missed claw, she springs onto the wolf's foreleg and sprints upward against it, landing two cuts along the snow-white fur — purple-white spirit sparks bursting at each stroke — then kicks free an instant before the jaws snap, flipping back into a long skid across the snow. High-speed tracking of her forest parkour, intercut with low-angle claw impacts, and a tight upward-angle chase on the foreleg run.

[6-9s] Battle at the shrine: the wolf god howls skyward, ice-blue light flaring from its body — unleashing its power of frost: the blizzard thickens to blot out the sky, countless ice lances condensing in the storm and raining toward her like arrows. Cutting as she retreats, her blade weaves an arcing curtain of purple-white light that shatters lance after lance, falling back into the shrine ruins — where the wolf's colossal body simply plows through: the torii bursts into spinning splinters, stone lanterns explode in rows, the half-fallen halls torn apart beneath its charge, timber and stone whirling into the blizzard. She chains leaps off a blasted pillar, gains the surviving shrine roof, and sprints along the snowy tiles as the claw smashes the roof down section by section behind her, always half a step ahead. Wide pull-back on the shrine's large-scale disintegration under the wolf, then a hard push-in chasing her sprint across the collapsing roofline.

[9-12s] Counterattack at the cliff: the roof ends at the broken cliff — without slowing she launches into the storm beyond the edge; the wolf god lunges after her, jaws closing on her mid-air — a razor's edge: she twists in the air, lands on a massive beam fragment hurled by the wolf's charge, and double-jumps off it higher still, now directly above the wolf's head — her straw hat rips away in the slipstream, purple-black hair and fox tail flaring in the blizzard as she plunges, both hands on the hilt, driving a full-force falling slash into the divine crest on the wolf god's brow! Purple-white light detonates; the wolf shrieks, its head slamming into the cliff face, half the rock wall collapsing. Riding the recoil she flips back to the clifftop snow, skidding to a stop on one knee. Camera dives with her falling POV over the edge, slow-motion and a frontal close-up as the slash bursts, then pulls wide on the crumbling cliff.

[12-15s] Standoff in the storm: the wolf god turns back from the cliff face, a glowing scar across its brow-crest, the ice-blue light in its eyes burning fiercer than before, the blizzard condensing into a spinning ring of ice crystals around it — not fallen, but hungrier for battle. At the cliff's edge she rises slowly, flicks the snow from her blade, levels the katana forward — and her wind-blown hat drifts down within reach; she catches it backhanded and sets it on her head, fox tail swaying, the ghost of a smile at her lips. The blizzard screams between them as girl and god lock eyes across the fallen cliff and the whirling snow — freeze frame on this mid-battle moment of the relentless boss fight: the beast's divine light undimmed, the wanderer's blade unsheathed, the next clash a breath away.

Style: Eastern fantasy × AAA action game × colossal boss battle, with Ghost of Tsushima's snow-and-steel atmosphere, Black Myth: Wukong's Eastern boss staging, and Nioh's divine-beast oppression. Character design strictly consistent throughout: flower-adorned straw hat with fox mask, ultra-long purple-black hair, purple kimono dress with white floral patterns, single slipped sleeve, golden-brown fox tail, armored over-knee boots, gold-tsuba katana. Her combat identity is "the draw and the footwork": iai flash-cuts, blade-curtain parries, momentum chain-jumps, the falling slash — fox-light and lethally precise. The wolf god carries both divinity and mass: shimenawa and paper streamers marking its godhood, every movement wreaking large-scale frost destruction. The blizzard is the film's persistent dynamic element, escalating from drifting snow to whiteout to ice-lance storm as the battle builds. Palette: snow white, deep purple, ice-blue divine light, purple-white blade-light, golden-brown fox tail, faded vermilion torii. Lighting: cold blue dusk base, the wolf's ice-blue eye and crest glow, warm purple-white spirit-light in opposition, snowfield bounce. Camera: exploding-mist wide, tight evasion tracking, foreleg-run upward angle, shrine-disintegration panorama, cliff-dive POV, slow-motion falling-slash close-up, final standoff freeze — no hard cuts. 4K, cinematic lighting, HDR, rich snow-grain and ice-crystal detail.
